name: Core Keeper
description: Mods for Core Keeper, made with the Pugstorm Mod SDK.
notice: Multiplayer: the host (or dedicated server) and every player must have the same mods at the same versions. If anyone is missing a mod or has a different version, they can't join or the game may break. After an update, everyone should press "Install / update all" before playing.
